description: This PHP source file provides a base implementation for PDO drivers within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes classes for PDO connection handling, statements, record sets, and specific methods for interacting with databases via PDO, as well as driver-specific extensions and utilities.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo
classes.description: Main class for PDO-based database connections, managing connection setup, executing queries, and transaction control.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_base
classes.description: Base class for driver-specific PDO implementations providing default methods and properties.

classes.name: ADOPDOStatement
classes.description: Handles prepared statements and their execution, parameter binding, error handling, and result fetching.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_pdo
classes.description: Represents a set of records retrieved via PDO, supports iteration, field access, and metadata.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_pdo
classes.description: An extension of record set for array-based fetching (details omitted).

methods.name: adodb_pdo_type
methods.description: Maps PDO parameter types to human-readable string representations.

methods.name: adodb_pdo
methods.description: Main class for connecting to a database via PDO, managing connection parameters, error handling, and executing queries.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo_base::_init
methods.description: Initializes driver-specific configurations with parent driver properties.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo_base::ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server info (default implementation calls parent class method).

methods.name: ADODB_pdo_base::SelectLimit
methods.description: Implements limit query with parent class behavior.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo_base::MetaTables
methods.description: Returns false, indicating not supported.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo_base::MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns false, indicating not supported.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement::__construct
methods.description: Initializes statement with PDO statement object and connection reference.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement::Execute
methods.description: Executes the PDO statement with optional input parameters.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement::InParameter
methods.description: Binds a parameter by reference to the statement.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement::Affected_Rows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the statement.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement::ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns error message for the statement.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement::NumCols
methods.description: Returns number of columns in the result set.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement::ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns error code for the statement.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::__construct
methods.description: Constructs the record set, initializing fetch mode based on global settings.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::Init
methods.description: Initializes the record set, fetching row count and field metadata.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::_initrs
methods.description: Fetches number of rows and column metadata from PDO statement.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::FetchField
methods.description: Returns metadata object for a specified field.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::_seek
methods.description: Stub: seeking to a specific row returns false.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the PDO statement.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::_close
methods.description: Closes the current record set.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo::Fields
methods.description: Accesses field value by column name.
